ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly bimodal pixel intensity distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized on the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels localized in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) regions occupy the distal 1/3 of both left and right lobes; a central low-intensity (black) region contains scattered high-intensity circular and punctate patterns concentrated in the medial zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying approximately 12% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; serrations are more acute and jagged on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips with a slight downward curvature at the extreme left tip due to biological accumulation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered high-intensity annular (ring-shaped) pixels, approximately 5-20 pixels in diameter, distributed across the central black pigmentation zone and lower medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible in the high-intensity white region of the left lobe and crossing the boundary of the central black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel masses (barnacle clusters) on the distal tip of the left lobe and scattered along the trailing edge of the right lobe; numerous circular pigmentation scars present across the black surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dense colony of acorn barnacles on the upper left tip creates a localized irregular expansion of the trailing edge perimeter, altering the macro-level fluke geometry at that coordinate.
